intent: To illustrate the growth in the proportion of adult internet users posting online video from 2009 to 2013.

requirements.question: Must the 2009 baseline (14%) be explicitly conveyed?
Must the 2013 endpoint (31%) be explicitly conveyed?
Is the upward direction required as a separate unit, or is it implied by the two endpoint values?
Are all data marks declared by G0 present in the required state or states?

units.claim: In 2009, 14% of adult internet users posted online video.

basis.note: Table row for 2009 gives value=14 and unit=%.

accept: 14% of adult internet users posted online video in 2009.
units.evidence: The 2009 value 14% must be visible or labeled.

units.claim: In 2013, 31% of adult internet users posted online video.

basis.note: Table row for 2013 gives value=31 and unit=%.

accept: 31% of adult internet users posted online video in 2013.
By 2013, the share had reached 31 percent.
units.evidence: The 2013 value 31% must be visible or labeled.

units.claim: The proportion posting online video increased from 2009 to 2013; 2013 is higher than 2009.
accept: The share rose from 14% in 2009 to 31% in 2013.
There was an upward change over the period.
units.evidence: The visual encoding must make clear that the 2013 value exceeds the 2009 value.

units.claim: All 2 required bar marks or stacked segments appear in the final chart.
accept: all 2 required data marks are visible
the complete required mark set is present in the final chart
reject: omitting any required bar or stacked segment
replacing missing marks with a summary total or subtitle
units.evidence: G0 data-row coverage is rendered as a complete set of identifiable bar marks.

optional_valid: The time span is four years: 2013 - 2009 = 4.
The 2009 value is about 45.16% of the 2013 value: 14 / 31 = 0.4516.

clip_hardcase.reason: The reference SVG has no explicit data-role=bar mark, so visual-unit reconstruction needs manual review.

hardcases.handling: Requires human visual inspection before semantic scoring.
